name: Scream!
source:
Kyouhei Fujimine stole a sample of female urine from the school clinic. 
That night he drank it and gained the power of mind control. 
In the days that followed Kyouhei applied his hypnotist ways on students. 
His languid, pointless life had just become a fountain of fantasy. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096035.html]DLsite English[/url]]
